blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding and modeling light transport in human-centric scenes is a longstanding challenge. While recent progress in diffusion models has boosted research in relighting, precise illumination control still lags, primarily due to the scarcity of diverse, high-quality, precisely labeled video relighting datasets. Existing end-to-end relighting approaches model light transport implicitly through neural networks, which substantially complicates controllability. In contrast, some works resort to path-traced irradiance cues as an explicit blueprint for light transport. However, such constructed irradiance cues are prone to artifacts and hinder generative quality when directly used as control signals. With the key observation that noise corruption removes high-frequency artifacts and preserves low-frequency light transport, we introduce an asynchronous joint-modeling paradigm that facilitates fine-grained illumination control. During two-stage training, we force the model to jointly denoise RGB and ground-truth irradiance frames with separate timesteps scheduling. A domain matching strategy is applied to the second stage to bridge the domain gap between irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. At inference time, we introduce an asynchronous hijacked generation pipeline that facilitates flexible illumination control. For training data, we develop a multi-illumination high-quality synthetic video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model exhibits robust generalization to real- world scenarios and outperforms prior approaches in both lighting fidelity and generative quality. The code and dataset will be publicly released.
blocks.zh: 在以人为中心的场景中理解并建模轻型运输是一个长期的挑战。 虽然最近在传播模型方面的进展推动了再点亮方面的研究,但准确的照明控制仍然滞后,主要原因是缺乏多样、高质量、贴有准确标签的视频再点亮数据集。 现有的端到端再照方法模式光传输隐含地通过神经网络,这极大地使可控性复杂化. 相形之下,一些工程采用路径跟踪辐射提示作为光能运输的明确蓝图. 然而,这种已建成的辐照道口在直接用作控制信号时容易出现文物并会妨碍基因质量。 以噪声腐败能去除高频文物并保存低频光能运输的关键观察,我们引入了一种同步联合模型范式来方便精细的发光控制. 在两个阶段的训练中,我们强迫模型联合去除RGB和地面-真实辐射框架,并分别安排时间步骤。 第二阶段采用了域匹配策略来弥合辐射提示和地-真辐射图之间的域间隙. 在推论中,我们引入了一个同步被劫持的发电管道,以方便灵活的照明控制。 对于训练数据,我们利用强大的游戏引擎开发出多发光能高品质的合成视频数据集,并配对出辐射图. 我们的模型专门对这一数据集进行了培训,显示了对现实世界情景的强烈概括,在照明忠诚度和基因质量方面都超过了以往的做法。 代码和数据集将公开发布.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Lighting fundamentally affects how we perceive a scene. Modifying lighting while preserving scene identity enables a wide range of applications, such as artistic creation, film production, augmented reality, and computer vision research. Fundamentally, relighting requires an understanding of how light interacts with the scene. Traditional graphics pipelines simulate physical light transport with explicit geometry and materials. For objects and portraits, meticulously calibrated studio equipment ( Debevec, 2012 ) is used to reconstruct geometry and capture reflectance fields. However, real-world scenes comprise complex combinations of objects and persons, of which the geometry and material properties are impractical to capture. Relighting of human-centric scenes in diverse indoor and outdoor environments thus remains a challenging task.
blocks.zh: 灯光从根本上影响着我们如何看待一个场景。 在保留场景身份的同时修改照明可以实现广泛的应用,如艺术创作,电影制作,增强现实,以及计算机视觉研究. 从根本上说,重燃需要了解光与场景的相互作用. 传统的图形管道以明显的几何和材料模拟物理光传输. 对于物体和肖像,精细校准的工作室设备(Debevec,2012年)用于重建几何和捕捉反射场. 然而,现实世界的场景由物体和人物的复杂组合组成,其中几何学和物质属性是不切实际的. 因此,在不同的室内和室外环境中重现以人为中心的场景仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。

blocks.en: With the advent of powerful generative models, relighting with a single image or video input has drawn increasing attention. It is an innately ill-posed problem, since geometry, material, and lighting are all coupled in the single input. Some works ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ) construct degradation pairs for real-world images or videos and train end-to-end diffusion models for relighting. These methods, lacking explicit physical light transport modeling, are typically constrained to text prompts or environment maps as conditioning inputs, failing to offer precise control over lighting parameters such as light source angles. Some other works ( Liang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) utilize graphics engines to construct synthetic data, enabling relighting with environment maps as a condition. Such synthetic data are limited to simple object-centric scenes, hindering generalization to complex human-centric real-world scenarios. More importantly, implicit light transport modeling within neural networks cannot guarantee physical accuracy.
blocks.zh: 随着强大的基因模型的出现,以单一的图像或视频输入重现,引起了越来越多的关注. 这是一个天生不便的问题,因为几何、材料和照明都与单项输入相结合。 一些作品(张等人,2025b;方方等人,2025;刘等人,2025c)为真实世界的影像或视频构建降解配对,并训练端到端的传播模型进行重燃. 这些方法缺乏明显的物理光传输模型,通常受文字提示或环境图作为条件输入的限制,无法对光源角度等照明参数提供精确的控制. 其他一些作品(梁等人,2025年;He等人,2025年)利用图形引擎构建合成数据,从而能够以环境地图为条件重新点亮. 这种合成数据仅限于简单的以物体为中心的场景,阻碍了对复杂的以人为中心的现实世界情景的概括. 更重要的是,神经网络内隐含的光传输模型不能保证物理精度.

blocks.en:
Recent advances in monocular geometry estimation ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Wang et al., 2025f ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Mescheder et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) have opened new avenues for scene relighting.
While monocular point clouds serve as a coarse geometric proxy, they are unsuitable for direct integration into traditional graphics pipelines due to single-layer geometry and artifacts from depth discontinuities at object boundaries.
With a diffuse white BRDF and physics-based rendering, this proxy produces an irradiance cue that characterizes the scene’s diffuse light transport, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Although this irradiance cue remains plagued by artifacts and exhibits a significant domain gap relative to the ground-truth irradiance map, we propose that this discrepancy can be effectively bridged through noise corruption. The key observation is that after blending with a certain amount of Gaussian noise, the rough irradiance cue and ground-truth irradiance map become indistinguishable.
In this way, noise corruption mitigates the domain gap by removing high-frequency artifacts and preserving low-frequency content. We then model this rough irradiance distribution via the diffusion process. During training, the model jointly denoises RGB video and irradiance maps with separate timestep scheduling, learning to transform a noised irradiance cue into a pixel-aligned fine-grained irradiance map. At inference time, we render the irradiance cue using a geometry estimate and the target lighting with a path tracer. The irradiance cue is then noised and jointly denoised with the RGB video.
blocks.zh:
最近在单体几何估计方面取得的进展(Wang等人,2025e;Wang等人,2025f;Lin等人,2025;Mescheder等人,2025;Wang等人,2025a)为场景重现开辟了新的途径。
单点云虽然作为粗几何的代称,但由于单层几何和物体边界深度不连续的文物,它们不适合直接融入传统图形管道.
以散射的白色 BRDF 和以物理为基础的渲染,这个代用产生一个辐射提示, 描述场景的散射光传输, 虽然这一辐射提示仍然受到文物的困扰,并显示出与地面-真实辐射图相比存在重大领域差距,但我们建议通过噪音腐败有效地弥合这一差距。 关键观察是,在与一定数量的高斯噪音混合后,粗糙的辐射提示和地面-真实辐射图变得不可分.
这样,噪声腐败通过去除高频文物和保存低频内容来缓解域间隙. 然后通过扩散过程模拟这种粗糙的辐射分布。 在训练期间,该模型联合将RGB视频和辐照地图进行分时段调度,学习将噪声辐照提示转换成像素对齐的细纹辐照地图. 推论时,我们用几何估计值 和带有路径追踪器的目标照明值 来制作辐射提示。 辐照提示随即被点名,并与RGB视频联合取消.

blocks.en: For training data, we develop a large-scale human-centric multi-illumination video dataset with paired irradiance maps using a powerful game engine. It contains 68K synthetic videos from 6.8K dynamic scenes across 30 artist-made 3D environments. A character performing random actions is placed in the center of the camera, where random camera shake and camera movement are applied. Each scene is rendered with 10 different lighting conditions sampled from 821 HDR environment maps, of which 20% are set to rotating.
blocks.zh: 对于训练数据,我们利用强大的游戏引擎,开发一个大规模以人为中心的多光度视频数据集,并配对辐射图. 它包含来自6.8K动态场景的68K合成视频,覆盖30个艺术家制作的3D环境. 一个进行随机动作的人物被放置在镜头的中央,在那里应用随机相机摇动和相机运动. 每个场景都有10个不同的照明条件从821 HDR环境地图中取样,其中20%被设定为旋转.

blocks.en:
Experimental results show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art realistic video relighting approaches in both relighting fidelity and video quality. Ablation studies verify the effectiveness of our key designs.
To summarize, we present three main contributions: • An asynchronous RGB-irradiance joint-modeling approach with separate timestep scheduling, plus a domain matching strategy that bridges the gap between noisy irradiance cues and ground-truth irradiance maps. • A high-quality human-centric multi-illumination video dataset with paired irradiance maps across diverse indoor and outdoor lighting conditions. This dataset will be publicly released to advance research in human-centric video relighting and intrinsic decomposition. • Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on video relighting in both visual quality and lighting fidelity.
blocks.zh:
实验结果显示,我们的方法在重新点亮忠贞度和视频质量方面都超过了最先进的现实视频。 校勘研究验证了我们关键设计的有效性.
总而言之,我们提出三项主要贡献: 一个同步的 RGB 辐射联合模型方法, 并有单独的时序表, 加上一个域匹配策略, • 支助 高品质的以人为中心的多光照视频数据集,并配对辐射图,跨越不同室内外照明条件. 该数据集将公开发布,以推进以人为中心的视频重燃和内在分解的研究. • 支助 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在视觉质量和照明忠贞性方面都取得了最新效果。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
While object-centric ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Zeng et al., 2024b ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Bharadwaj et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2025 ) and portrait-centric ( Lv et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ; Saito et al., 2024 ; Chaturvedi et al., 2025 ; Mei et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) static relighting have been extensively explored, human-centric video relighting in dynamic indoor and outdoor scenes remains underexplored.
Many works ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) rely on degradation pairs with text prompts or environment maps, but provide only coarse control and often produce stylized results. ( Liang et al., 2026 ) use path tracing rendering as an anchor point to online optimize static relighting results, which cannot extend to dynamic scenes.
DiffusionRenderer ( Liang et al., 2025 ) curates synthetic multi-illumination data with simple objects and paired G-buffers, training separate inverse and forward rendering models. UniRelight ( He et al., 2025 ) further extends this to end-to-end video relighting. However, both methods input environment maps directly without explicit light transport guidance, limiting generalization in complex scenes with occlusions. In contrast, our method targets general dynamic scenes beyond portraits and employs physically-based irradiance cues to achieve more accurate lighting control.

许多作品(张等,2025b;方等,2025b;刘等,2025c;刘等,2025a;周等,2025;曾等,2025;刘等,2026;林等,2026;赵等,2024)依靠有文字提示或环境图的降解对子,但只提供粗糙的控制,常产生结晶效果. (Liang et al., 2026)将路径追踪渲染作为在线优化静态再点效果的锚点,无法延伸至动态场景.
扩散渲染器 (Liang等人,2025年)用简单的物体和配对的G-buffers来解析合成的多光学数据,训练分离的反向和前向渲染模型. UniRelight (He et al., 2025) 进一步将它扩展到端对端视频重燃. 然而,两种方法都直接输入环境图,而没有明确的光传输导线,限制了在复杂场景中带有遮蔽的泛化. 相比之下,我们的方法针对的是肖像以外的一般动态场景,并采用基于物理的辐射提示,以实现更准确的照明控制.

blocks.en: Several related systems target narrower capture settings or different control interfaces. SwitchLight ( Kim et al., 2024 ) decomposes a single portrait using a physics-guided architecture and relights it from an environment map, whereas DifFRelight ( He et al., 2024 ) learns subject-specific facial-performance relighting from light-stage data. Relightable Full-Body Gaussian Codec Avatars ( Wang et al., 2025d ) models local and non-local light transport for captured, personalized avatars. ReLumix ( Wang et al., 2025b ) propagates the illumination of one artist-relit reference frame through a video rather than taking a target environment map directly. The commercial Runway Relight Scene system ( Runway, 2026 ) instead uses text descriptions to edit the atmosphere of short videos. These methods demonstrate complementary progress, but do not address pixel-aligned, environment-map-controlled relighting of general monocular human-centric videos in the wild.
blocks.zh: 若干相关系统针对较窄的捕捉设置或不同的控制界面. SwitchLight(Kim 等人,2024年)利用物理制导架构分解一幅单幅肖像,并从环境图中重新点燃,而DifFrelight(He等人,2024年)则从光相数据中学习到特定主题的面部性能重燃. 易燃的全博迪高斯密码阿凡达斯(Wang et al.,2025d)为俘获的,个性化的阿凡达人模拟当地和非当地轻型运输. ReLumix(Wang等人,2025b)通过视频宣传一个艺术家折射参考框架的照明,而不是直接拍摄目标环境图. 商业的Runway Relight Scene系统(Runway,2026)转而使用文字描述来编辑短视频的氛围. 这些方法展现了互补的进步,但并不涉及像素对齐,环境图控的在野外一般单体人心视频的重燃.

blocks.en: RGB ↔ \leftrightarrow X ( Zeng et al., 2024a ) shows pixel-aligned irradiance maps can serve as lighting control signals, but require an existing clean irradiance map as input. DiLightNet ( Zeng et al., 2024b ) , PractiLight ( Erel et al., 2025 ) , and Lightit ( Kocsis et al., 2024 ) compute irradiance cues from target lighting and coarse depth, but misalignment with the input image due to noisy geometry undermines relighting quality. Portrait-specific relighting methods such as Total Relighting ( Pandey et al., 2021 ) focus on human faces and use image-based lighting without path-traced shadows, which is suitable for portrait photography but less applicable to general scenes.

blocks.en: Diffusion models have been applied to jointly model pixel-aligned attributes such as depth ( Li et al., 2025 ; Byung-Ki et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , motion ( Chefer et al., 2025 ) , and PBR attributes ( Xi et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ) . Joint modeling approaches include dual-stream cross-attention ( Li et al., 2025 ; Byung-Ki et al., 2025 ) and various single-model injection paradigms ( Chefer et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025a ; Xi et al., 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Most such methods assume clean auxiliary modalities; in contrast, we must handle imperfect irradiance cues with substantial geometry artifacts—a domain-gap issue largely unexplored in prior work. The use of per-modality asynchronous timestep schedules has been explored in UniDiffuser ( Bao et al., 2023 ) , AVDiT ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and Uni-Renderer ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , but none addresses imperfect auxiliary modalities at inference time. Our key contribution is applying this idea to the RGB-irradiance pairing, combined with domain matching and hijacked inference to handle noisy real-world irradiance cues.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型已应用于诸如深度(Li等人,2025年;Byung-Ki等人,2025年;Xi等人,2025年a;Chen等人,2025年a),运动(Chefer等人,2025年)和PBR属性(Xi等人,2025年b); He等人,2025年). 联合建模方法包括双流跨流(Li等人,2025年;Byung-Ki等人,2025年)和各种单型注射模式(Chefer等人,2025年;习近平等人,2025年a); Xi等人,2025年b;He等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a) 大多数这类方法都假定有清洁的辅助方式;相反,我们必须用大量的几何文物处理不完善的辐照提示——这个领域差距问题在以前的工作中基本上没有得到探讨。 在UniDiffuser(Bao等人,2023年),AVDIT(Wang等人,2024年a)和Uni-Render(Chen等人,2025年b)中,都探讨了使用同步时序表的问题,但没有一个涉及推论时不完善的辅助方式。 我们的主要贡献是将这个想法应用于RGB辐射配对,结合域匹配和被劫持的推论,处理响亮的现实世界辐射提示.

blocks.en: Training a video relighting network requires paired multi-illumination data with lighting annotation. Existing datasets ( Murmann et al., 2019 ; Teufel et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) mainly cover static images in restricted scenarios, and prior works ( Liang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) use only simple rendered scenes. Unreal Engine 5 ( Epic Games, 2019 ) enables high-quality human-centric multi-illumination video synthesis with accurate lighting annotation.
blocks.zh: 培训视频再照明网络需要配对的多照明数据与照明注释. 现有数据集(Murmann等人,2019年;Teufel等人,2025年;Liu等人,2023年)主要涵盖受限情景中的静态图像,之前的作品(Liang等人,2025年;He等人,2025年)只使用简单的渲染场景. 非真实引擎5 (Epic Games, 2019) 实现了高品质的以人为中心的多发光视频合成,并有准确的照明注释.

blocks.zh: 3个 初步

blocks.en:
Our study builds on a transformer-based latent diffusion model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . The architecture comprises a 3D Variational Autoencoder (VAE) and a diffusion transformer (DiT) of spatio-temporal transformer blocks. Each block integrates 3D spatio-temporal self-attention, cross-attention, feed-forward network, and gate modulation. blocks.en: 4. Training Dataset
blocks.zh: 4个 培训数据集

blocks.en: We build an automated UE5 pipeline for multi-illumination videos. Our assets include 30 3D environments, 60 characters, 600 body animations, 20 facial expressions, and 821 HDR environment maps. Figure 4 overviews the dataset. For each scene, a character is randomly placed and animated, while the camera is assigned random distance, rotation, and oscillation. Ray intersection tests prevent interpenetration. We use UE5’s real-time global illumination system Lumen ( Tan, 2024 ) for efficient low-frequency approximation, and add a directional light to match the brightest region of the environment map. LightingOnly mode renders the irradiance map synchronously. Each scene is rendered under 10 illuminations, with 20% using rotary lighting. In total, we render 68K videos at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution, 94 frames each, with paired irradiance maps. Lighting parameters are recorded, and prompts are generated using a video understanding model ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Among the 30 scene environments, 12 are indoor scenes and 18 are outdoor scenes. The 821 HDR environment maps are collected from public resources such as Poly Haven, covering diverse illumination conditions including outdoor daytime, indoor, and outdoor nighttime settings. We pair the MetaHuman characters with Mixamo animations and mainly keep in-place motions such as talking, dancing, and fighting, while filtering out large-displacement motions such as walking and running to better match our camera setup.

blocks.en:
The set contains 31 male-presenting and 29 female-presenting characters; 22 dark-, 12 medium-, and 26 light-skinned characters; and 4 child, 43 adult, and 13 older characters.
Our dataset focuses on human-centric indoor and outdoor scenarios, enabling precise lighting control over human subjects. Despite being trained purely on synthetic data, our model generalizes well to real-world videos. We attribute this to the high photorealism of UE5-rendered content, which substantially reduces the sim-to-real gap compared to prior Blender-based synthetic datasets. This aligns with observations from prior works trained exclusively on UE-rendered videos, such as ReCamMaster ( Bai et al., 2025 ) and Context-as-Memory ( Yu et al., 2025 ) .

我们的数据集侧重于以人类为中心的室内和室外情景,从而能够准确控制人类主体的照明。 尽管我们只接受过合成数据方面的训练,但我们的模型对现实世界的视频进行了很好的概括。 我们将此归因于UE5-递归内容的高光现实性,与之前的Blender合成数据集相比,它大大缩小了sim-to-real差距. 这与以往专门培训的UE视频的作品,如ReCamMaster(Bai等人,2025年)和Context-as-Memory(Yu等人,2025年)的观察一致。

blocks.en: 5. Method
blocks.zh: 5.五. 方法

blocks.en: We first describe how to construct the irradiance cue 𝐄 cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}} for an input video 𝐕 I \mathbf{V}^{I} , then present our asynchronous RGB-irradiance joint modeling and hijacked inference strategy for generating the relit video 𝐕 \mathbf{V} and refined irradiance map 𝐄 ^ cue \hat{\mathbf{E}}^{\text{cue}} .

blocks.en: 5.1. Irradiance cue
blocks.zh: 5.1. 辐射提示

blocks.en: An irradiance cue describes diffuse light transport obtained by rendering scene geometry with target lighting. Previous works ( Zeng et al., 2024b ; Erel et al., 2025 ) use monocular depth ( Bhat et al., 2023 ) and unproject it to a mesh. We instead use monocular point-cloud estimation ( Wang et al., 2025e ; Wang et al., 2025f ) to obtain metric-level geometry and smoother meshes. We convert each estimated point cloud into a per-frame mesh and remove triangles spanning depth discontinuities with a fixed threshold-based mask. We assign a spatially uniform white diffuse BRDF , illuminate the mesh with the target environment map, and render it using Mitsuba 3 ( Jakob et al., 2022 ) . Repeating this process independently for every frame yields the irradiance cue 𝐄 cue ∈ ℝ F × H × W × 3 \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}\in\mathbb{R}^{F\times H\times W\times 3} for an input video 𝐕 \mathbf{V} . Per-frame estimation avoids accumulating global reconstruction drift, but geometry errors, removed boundary triangles, and temporal inconsistency still create a substantial gap from the ground-truth irradiance 𝐄 \mathbf{E} (Figure 3 ).

blocks.en: 5.2. Joint modeling with separate timestep scheduling
blocks.zh: 5.2. 采用不同时间步骤安排的联合模型

blocks.en: Directly using the imperfect irradiance cue 𝐄 cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}} causes model confusion due to pixel misalignment. To retain its low-frequency lighting prior while suppressing artifacts, we corrupt it with Gaussian noise ϵ \epsilon : (4) 𝐄 t cue = ( 1 − t ) ​ 𝐄 cue + t ​ ϵ . \displaystyle\mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}_{t}=(1-t)\mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}+t\epsilon. In this way, the high-frequency artifacts are removed and the global light transport prior is preserved. Simple hole filling or spatial blurring cannot reliably reconstruct light transport around undefined geometry and may erase useful low-frequency lighting structure; joint denoising instead learns how much of the corrupted cue to retain. To exploit this prior, we jointly model irradiance maps and RGB videos within the diffusion framework.

Given an input video 𝐕 I \mathbf{V}^{I} and a text prompt p p , we train a model v Θ v_{\Theta} that jointly denoises the relit RGB video 𝐕 \mathbf{V} and irradiance map 𝐄 \mathbf{E} using separate timesteps t V t_{V} and t E t_{E} . This allows the model to learn denoising under mismatched noise levels and enables inference with noisy irradiance conditions (Section 5.3 ).
As illustrated in Figure 2 , we concatenate the latents of noisy RGB video 𝐳 t V V \mathbf{z}_{t_{V}}^{V} , noisy irradiance map 𝐳 t E E \mathbf{z}_{t_{E}}^{E} and input video 𝐳 0 I \mathbf{z}_{0}^{I} along the frame dimension and feed into the transformer. This simple strategy allows the 3D spatial-temporal self-attention to cover input, irradiance and relit frames, enabling cross-modal understanding. While asynchronous timestep scheduling has been explored in prior multi-modal diffusion work ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , our contribution lies in applying it to the RGB-irradiance pairing, where the auxiliary modality is imperfect at inference time. This motivates our domain matching strategy and hijacked inference pipeline, which are essential for bridging the gap to noisy real-world irradiance cues.

blocks.en: Since the three input modalities share pixel alignment, we apply the same RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) to assign shared spatial-temporal positions. To distinguish modalities, we introduce a learnable modality embedding on top of the timestep embedding, whose gate modulation already conditions features on timestep. Unlike prior designs that inject modality embeddings into latent features, this better avoids modality mixture in our setting.

blocks.en: Since the model only observes the ground-truth irradiance map 𝐄 \mathbf{E} during standard training, conditioning on imperfect irradiance cues at inference introduces a domain gap. We address this with a domain matching paradigm: at random training iterations, we replace the noisy irradiance map 𝐳 t E \mathbf{z}_{t}^{E} with the noisy cue 𝐳 t E cue \mathbf{z}_{t}^{E^{\text{cue}}} . This encourages denoising towards a probability path closer to the high-quality manifold and improves both RGB and irradiance generation. This design is fundamentally different from previous joint cross-modal modeling methods, which usually assume clean and reliable modalities during both training and inference. In contrast, our framework is explicitly designed for imperfect irradiance cues with domain discrepancies, which are common in practical relighting settings. It also differs from prior irradiance-conditioned methods that directly feed the estimated cue into the generator, making them more vulnerable to accumulated geometry and rendering errors.

blocks.en: 5.3. Hijacked asynchronous inference strategy
blocks.zh: 5.3. 劫持同步推断战略

blocks.en: In Section 5.1 we show how to construct the irradiance cue 𝐄 cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}} , given an input video and a target lighting condition. In order to utilize it during inference, we design a hijacked conditional inference strategy that guides the sampling process towards the probability path indicated by the irradiance cue. We illustrate this process in Figure 3 . Specifically, we obtain the noisy irradiance cue 𝐄 t h cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}_{t_{h}} with Eq. 4 , where t h t_{h} is the hijack timestep. Before t h t_{h} , at each timestep only the noisy RGB latents are updated while the irradiance latents remain fixed at 𝐄 t h cue \mathbf{E}^{\text{cue}}_{t_{h}} . After t h t_{h} , the two modalities are denoised together. This strategy effectively utilizes low-frequency lighting prior provided by the noisy irradiance map, while removing high-frequency artifacts by joint denoising. The hyperparameter t h t_{h} controls the amount of noise that is added to the irradiance cue, offering a flexible tradeoff between generation quality and lighting fidelity. In practice, we find that t h = 0.6 ​ T t_{h}=0.6T works well for most cases. When the irradiance cue is reliable, a smaller t h t_{h} helps preserve more high-frequency appearance details. When the cue is noisy or less aligned, a larger t h t_{h} is preferable because it suppresses artifacts more aggressively.

blocks.en: 6. Experiments
blocks.zh: 6. 实验

blocks.en: We fine-tune Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) for 12K steps at 832 × 480 832\times 480 resolution using a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and batch size 16. Domain matching is applied only during the last 4K steps. We apply this second-stage training after the first-stage joint modeling has largely converged, and empirically find that 4K steps are sufficient for the model to adapt to the imperfect irradiance-cue distribution. To further mitigate the visual characteristics of synthetic training data, we adopt a noise augmentation strategy inspired by ReCamMaster ( Bai et al., 2025 ) : a moderate level of noise (equivalent to 200–500 diffusion timesteps) is added to the conditional video latent during training, which discourages the model from relying on domain-specific synthetic cues and improves robustness at real-world inference time. We set the hijack timestep to t h = 0.6 ​ T t_{h}=0.6T for every experiment and do not retune it case by case.

blocks.en: We compare our method with the publicly available video relighting method DiffusionRenderer ( Liang et al., 2025 ) , UniRelight ( He et al., 2025 ) and Light-X ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Image relighting methods DiLightNet ( Zeng et al., 2024b ) and Neural-Gaffer ( Jin et al., 2024 ) are also included. We adopt the Cosmos ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) implementation version of DiffusionRenderer for a fair comparison. These methods allow environment maps as control signals. We additionally include prompt-based relighting methods, including IC-Light ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , Light-A-Video ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , TC-Light ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . For environment-map-conditioned methods we use the identical target HDR map; prompt-based methods instead receive best-effort captions derived from the target lighting, so exact direction and intensity cannot be guaranteed.
blocks.zh: 我们比较我们的方法与公开的视频再点灯方法,DiffusionRender(Liang等人,2025年),UniRelight (He等人,2025年)和Light-X(Liu等人,2025年a). 图像重燃方法DiLightNet(Zeng等人,2024b)和Neural-Gaffer(Jin等人,2024)也包括在内. 我们采用Cosmos(Agarwal等人,2025年)执行版的DivusionRender,以进行公平比较。 这些方法允许环境图作为控制信号. 此外,我们还包括快速照明方法,包括IC-Light(张等人,2025b),Light-A-Video(周等人,2025b),TC-Light(刘等人,2025b). 对于符合环境条件的方法,我们使用相同的目标HDR地图;而即时方法则得到来自目标照明的最佳标题,因此准确的方向和强度无法保证。

blocks.en: We use the test subset of our synthetic dataset for quantitative evaluation. It contains 100 test cases: 50 static-lighting cases ( SynthStatic ) and 50 rotary-lighting cases ( SynthDynamic ), each with an input video, relit target, and target environment map. For qualitative comparison, test cases are sampled from the HumanVid ( Wang et al., 2024b ) dataset. Since there is no publicly available video relighting dataset for quantitative evaluation, we follow previous video relighting methods such as DiffusionRenderer ( Liang et al., 2025 ) and UniRelight ( He et al., 2025 ) by using our proposed synthetic dataset for the video benchmark. To test cross-dataset generalization independently of our synthetic renderer, we additionally evaluate static images from HumanOLAT ( Teufel et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用我们合成数据集的测试子集进行定量评估。 它包含100个测试案例:50个静电照明案例(SynthStatic)和50个旋转照明案例(SynthDynamic),每个案例都有输入视频,重写目标,以及目标环境图. 为了进行质的比较,测试案例从HumanVid(Wang等人,2024b)数据集中取样. 由于没有公开的视频重新点亮数据集进行定量评价,我们采用以往的视频重新点亮方法,例如通过使用我们拟议的视频基准合成数据集来进行DiffusionRender(Liang等人,2025年)和UniRelight(He等人,2025年)。 为了独立于我们的合成渲染器来测试跨数据集的通用化,我们额外评价了来自HumanOLAT的静态图像(Teufel等人,2025年)。

Following prior works ( Jin et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) , we avoid per-channel rescaling and instead compare results directly with ground truth, enabling faithful evaluation of relighting fidelity.

blocks.en: 6.1. Evaluation

Figures 5 and 6 compare vertical and horizontal cases, respectively; the latter includes SynthStatic examples. Prompt-based methods including IC-Light, TC-Light, and Light-A-Video produce appealing lighting styles, but cannot precisely control lighting direction or ambient color because text prompts are ambiguous. These methods often produce warm tones and can retain hard input shadows, as in the second case of Figure 5 . Light-X and Neural Gaffer inherits much of the input lighting distribution and mainly modifies color tone, while DiLightNet produces low-quality results caused by inaccurate material estimates. DiffusionRenderer and UniRelight performs reasonably well in terms of light direction and color. However, inaccurate material estimation yields unrealistic skin and clothing textures (Figs. 6 and 5 ). It also causes identity drift, demonstrated on the third case of Figure 6 . More importantly, implicit light transport modeling sometimes fails to produce physically correct results. In Fig. 5 (third case), DiffusionRenderer mistakes yellow ambient light for the main source, ignoring the actual moon light. In contrast, our method models light transport with guidance from the path-traced irradiance cue, facilitating physically accurate illumination control. Although trained on human-centric data, our method also generalizes to the cat example in Figure 6 .

Light-X和Neural Gaffer继承了大部分的输入照明分布,并主要修改色彩色调,而DiLightNet则由于材料估计不准确而产生低质量的结果. 扩散渲染器和UniRelight在光线方向和颜色方面表现合理. 然而,不准确的材料估计会产生不切实际的皮肤和服装纹理(图6和图5)。 它还造成身份漂移,这在图6的第三个案例上得到证明。 更重要的是,隐含的光传输模型有时不能产生物理上正确的结果。 在图5(第三例)中,DifmusionRender错误了主源的黄色环境光,忽略了实际的月光. 与此相反,我们的方法模型是光传输, 以路径跟踪的辐射提示为引导, 方便物理上准确的照明控制。 我们的方法也概括到图6中的猫的例子。

blocks.en: A user study evaluated perceptual quality on in-the-wild videos. Participants viewed the relighting results, the input video, and the environment map, and rated methods from 1 to 5 on visual quality (VQ) and lighting fidelity (LF). The study involved 13 in-lab users, and average scores are reported in Table 1 . We evaluate 15 indoor and outdoor test cases in total. Before the study, we explain that visual quality measures the overall perceptual realism, including artifacts and temporal stability, while lighting fidelity evaluates how well the generated result matches the target illumination in terms of light direction, shadow, and highlight consistency. Compared to baselines, our results are consistently preferred on both dimensions.
blocks.zh: 一项用户研究评价了在迷幻视频上的视觉质量。 与会者观看了重新点亮的结果、输入视频和环境地图,并在视觉质量(VQ)和照明忠贞度(LF)方面对1至5的方法进行了评级。 该研究涉及13个实验室用户,平均得分见表1。 我们总共评估15个室内和室外测试案例。 在研究之前,我们解释,视觉质量衡量了整体的知觉现实主义,包括文物和时间稳定性,而照明忠贞度则评价所产生结果在光线方向,阴影,以及突出一致性方面与目标照明的匹配程度. 与基线相比,我们的结果在两个方面都一直比较可取。

blocks.en: 7. Ablation study
blocks.zh: 7. 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct ablation study on our asynchronous RGB-irradiance joint modeling and domain matching strategy with qualitative results in Figure 10 . Without the asynchronous joint modeling training paradigm, simply using the irradiance cue as control signal, the model fails to follow the light transport. Joint modeling alone does not sufficiently bridge the domain gap; domain matching is essential for producing pixel-aligned irradiance maps and physically plausible RGB results. Without it, the denoised irradiance maps exhibit black edges and blurred details, leading to suboptimal outputs. In contrast, the full recipe generates pixel-aligned RGB and irradiance images, producing physically accurate and visually plausible results.
blocks.zh: 我们进行关于我们同步的RGB辐射联合建模和域比对战略的研究,并在图10中得出质量结果。 没有同步的联合模型训练范式,仅仅使用辐射提示作为控制信号,模型无法跟随光传输. 单靠联合建模不足以弥合域间隙;域匹配对于生成像素相通的辐射图和物理上可信的RGB结果至关重要. 没有它,淡化的辐照图显示出黑色的边缘和模糊的细节,导致非最佳的输出. 相比之下,全食谱生成像素对齐的RGB和辐照图像,产生物理准确和视觉上可信的结果.

blocks.en:
We report quantitative ablation results in Tables 3 and 4 .
We additionally train a no-irradiance variant that receives only the target HDR environment map under the same data and optimization protocol, analogous to HDR-conditioned implicit relighting.
All ablation models are trained for 6K steps, with domain matching applied during the final 2K steps. HDR map conditioning does not provide pixel-aligned guidance for light distribution, which produces less accurate relighting results compared to irradiance conditioning. Joint modeling irradiance and RGB alone brings limited gains because the imperfect irradiance cue still causes a noticeable train-test mismatch. Introducing hijacked conditional generation and asynchronous timestep scheduling progressively improves both lighting fidelity and visual quality, while the domain matching strategy delivers the final performance boost by explicitly aligning the cue distribution with inference-time inputs. We also compare different modality embedding strategies and find that injecting the modality cue through the time embedding performs best, likely because it modulates the denoising process globally and reduces the ambiguity between RGB appearance and irradiance guidance.

所有衰竭模型都为6K步骤训练,在最后的2K步骤中应用域匹配. HDR映射调制不提供光线分布的像素配对指导,与辐照调制相比,光线配制产生更准确的再照效果. 联合建模辐照和RGB本身只带来有限的收益,因为不完善的辐照提示仍然造成明显的火车测试不匹配。 引入被劫持的有条件生成和同步的时序安排将逐步提高照明忠贞度和视觉质量,而域匹配策略则通过明确将提示分配与推断时间输入相匹配来提供最终性能助推. 我们还比较不同模式嵌入策略,发现在嵌入时间中注入模式提示最能发挥最大作用,因为它能在全球调节去诺过程,并减少RGB外观和辐照指导之间的模糊之处。

blocks.en: 8. Discussion
blocks.zh: 8. 讨论情况

blocks.en: We present JointLight, a human-centric video relighting framework that jointly models RGB and irradiance asynchronously. We also introduce a high-quality human-centric multi-illumination synthetic dataset covering indoor and outdoor scenarios, paired with ground-truth irradiance maps. Trained exclusively on this dataset, our model achieves state-of-the-art relighting quality and fidelity.
blocks.zh: 我们提出“联合光线”,一个以人为中心的视频重燃框架,将RGB和辐射同步模拟。 我们还采用了一套高质量的以人为中心的多光照合成数据集,涵盖室内外的情况,配有地面辐射图。 我们的模型专门在这个数据集上进行训练,实现了最先进的重燃质量和忠诚。

blocks.en: Our method depends on monocular geometry only through the rendered irradiance cue. Because geometry is estimated independently per frame, errors do not accumulate as global reconstruction drift. Noise injection suppresses high-frequency defects such as jagged boundaries, holes, and aliased shadows, but cannot recover light transport that is absent from severely incorrect geometry. Aggressive subject or camera motion can also produce blur and occlusion errors. Incorrect depths or holes near discontinuities may distort the path-traced cue and can cause light leakage (the bottom-right case in Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的方法依赖于单光度几何 只能通过辐射提示 由于每帧几何是独立估计的,因此误差不会随着全球重建漂移而累积. 噪声注射抑制了高频缺陷,如错位边界,孔,和别名阴影,但无法恢复严重不正确的几何中缺失的光传输. 侵略性主体或相机运动也可以产生模糊和隐蔽错误. 近不连续的不正确深度或孔可能扭曲路径跟踪提示,并可能导致光泄漏(图9中的右下方例)。

blocks.en: First, irradiance provides diffuse transport only and therefore cannot explicitly or physically control full specular transport. Video priors can synthesize plausible moderate highlights on skin and hair, but these effects are not guaranteed to follow the target illumination; polished metal, mirrors, and glass remain difficult. A failure case is shown in the bottom-right case of Figure 9 . Second, suppressing high-frequency cue errors can also attenuate texture-rich appearance, occasionally over-smoothing fine facial details around the eyes and mouth. Future work could jointly reason about geometry, material, diffuse and specular transport, and use detail-preserving or preference-based post-training. Extending the control representation beyond environment maps to local spotlights or flashlights is another promising direction.
blocks.zh: 首先,辐照只提供扩散运输,因此无法明确或实际控制全谱运输。 视频前情提要可以合成皮肤和头发上可视的中度亮点,但这些效果并不能保证跟随目标照明;抛光的金属,镜像和玻璃仍然很困难. 图9的右下方显示一个失败案例。 第二,压制高频提示错误也可以减轻纹理丰富的外观,偶尔会在眼睛和嘴周围过度吸动精细的面部细节. 今后的工作可以共同说明几何、材料、散射和光谱运输方面的理由,并使用细节保留或基于偏好的培训后方法。 将控制表达方式从环境图扩大到局部聚光灯或闪光灯是另一个有希望的方向。
